title: Prediction: prefrontal activity for decisions that nothing was seen

statements.text: The model predicts that awareness reports, but not discrimination performance, depend on higher-order states, so silencing them could yield a kind of blindsight. It also predicts prefrontal involvement when a subject actively decides a stimulus was absent, where global workspace theory predicts prefrontal quiet.
statements.falsification_criteria: Prefrontal cortex stays quiet on trials where subjects actively report that no stimulus was present, or silencing the putative awareness states leaves awareness reports unchanged.

sources.quote: Thus it may be possible to silence or otherwise inactivate the neural substrates of an awareness state without affecting performance
HOSS predicts prefrontal involvement for active decisions about stimulus absence, whereas GWS predicts that PFC remains quiescent on such trials
